project.name: 古埃及海报
project.styleDefinitionBrief: Ancient Egypt exhibition poster with desert gold, lapis lazuli blue, terracotta accents on sandstone background. Cinzel serif display type, Noto Serif body. Hieroglyphic-inspired decorative borders and geometric patterns. Dramatic cinematic lighting with warm golden tones.
project.designRead: Cultural exhibition poster / history enthusiasts and art lovers / dramatic ancient luxury / medium density / avoid cartoonish illustrations

colorSystem.primaryColorRole: Desert gold (#D4A843) for key display elements and ornamental borders
colorSystem.brandHuePolicy: Warm gold primary with lapis blue and terracotta as accent layers only

styleContinuityAnchors.shapeSystem: Sharp edges and angular geometric patterns inspired by Egyptian architecture; zero border-radius
styleContinuityAnchors.typographySystem: Cinzel Decorative for hero title, Cinzel for subtitles, Noto Serif for body; all-caps tracking-wider for display text
styleContinuityAnchors.spacingSystem: Generous padding for dramatic breathing room between sections
styleContinuityAnchors.componentLanguage: Ornamental borders, wing-shaped geometric dividers, lotus and papyrus decorative motifs
styleContinuityAnchors.surfaceAndDepth: Border-led layering with gold metallic borders; subtle warm shadows for depth
styleContinuityAnchors.imageryAndIconography: Egyptian hieroglyphics, pharaoh motifs, pyramid silhouettes, ankh symbols, eye of Horus

designSource.designDecisionSummary: Desert gold + lapis lazuli + terracotta palette on sandstone background. Cinzel Decorative display, Noto Serif body. Sharp angular edges, hieroglyphic ornamental borders. Generous spacing for dramatic effect.

pages.title: 古埃及海报
pages.businessScenario: Ancient Egypt cultural exhibition poster - single page dramatic visual layout
pages.visualNorthStar: A dramatic, cinematic poster that evokes the majesty and mystery of ancient Egypt through golden ornamental borders, deep lapis blue contrasts, and hieroglyphic-inspired decorative elements framing a central exhibition announcement
pages.compositionPattern: Full-bleed poster: ornamental border frame wrapping entire canvas, dramatic top-to-bottom hierarchy with winged sun disc header, central hero visual, stylized title block, and footer with event details. Asymmetric gold and blue contrast bands.

assets.semanticDescription: Ancient Egyptian artifact or pharaoh imagery with dramatic golden lighting and lapis blue accents
